title: Verifier result file (/workspace/.run/verify.json)
description: Written by pipeline/verify.js (owner: the verifier task, T7 - DESIGN.md 4.4). Frozen input to the runner (done-vs-partial decision, PR body) and the report generator. The runner maps: acceptance=pass + build in {pass, absent} + regressions in {pass, absent} -> done; acceptance=pass + build in {pass, absent} + regressions=fail -> partial (4.11). A build=fail cannot return success - the verifier exits 1 (repo-cl9).

acceptance.description: The authoritative gate: the frozen acceptance tests' verdict.

build.description: The optional required build gate's verdict (repo-cl9, DESIGN.md 4.4). Runs the frozen config's buildCommand after acceptance; a 'fail' forces the verifier to exit 1 even when acceptance passed. 'absent' = no buildCommand in the frozen config (every legacy target).

regressions.description: The project suite's verdict - recorded evidence, never the gate. 'absent' = no regressionCommand in the frozen config.

tamperedPaths.description: Frozen paths that differ from the fork point (present iff acceptance=tampered).

acceptanceOutput.description: Tail of the acceptance run's output - the feedback fed into the next coding attempt and the PR's verification evidence.

buildOutput.description: Tail of the build run's output (present iff buildCommand ran). Carried into the next coding attempt's feedback when build=fail, and shown as PR/report build evidence (repo-cl9).

error.description: Present iff acceptance=error (missing ISSUE_ID, unreadable frozen config).
